hook: In chronic norovirus infection, the virus persists in gut cells and macrophages and skews T cell signaling.
summary: How norovirus causes lasting disease is poorly understood. Single-cell RNA sequencing of duodenal biopsies and lab-grown enteroids from immunodeficient patients found viral RNA mainly in enterocytes, enteroendocrine cells and macrophages, alongside higher IL15 and interferon gamma and chemokines that recruit T cells. The patients are few and immunodeficient, so findings may not extend to typical infections.
title: Single-cell profiling of the duodenum during chronic human norovirus infection.
